ValidationRule.description: Department Action cases should be Closed with Resolution status.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.Case_Validation_Bypass__c.Bypass_Validation__c), AND( ISPICKVAL(CaseCategory__c, 'Department Action'), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'New')), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'In Progress')), ISBLANK(ParentId), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status,'Closed with Resolution')) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Department Action cases should be Closed with Resolution status.
